name: Prisma Properties AB (publ)
summary: Prisma Properties AB (publ) owns, develops, and leases retail properties in discount retail, food and grocery retail, and quick service restaurant sectors in Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Norway. It has a agreement to acquire a fully let grocery property in Værløse and retail property in Pietarsaari, Finland through a forward purchase transaction. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
